end.summary:
Navya discussed the story “The Cap-seller and the Monkeys.”
They identified that the monkeys copied the cap-seller’s action.
They explained that throwing his own cap made the monkeys throw theirs too.
The lesson stopped when Navya said they felt tired.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the story’s main event with Navya by asking what the monkeys copied and how the cap-seller got the caps back. Navya connected the monkeys’ copying to a cartoon and explained the ending; the lesson ended before teach-back was completed. At home, you can retell the story together using three picture steps: take caps, copy the action, collect the caps.
